surviving_claim: In the tested single-writer local SQLite WAL + synchronous=FULL model, one logical admission plus one bounded migration step and routing metadata is process-crash atomic: real SIGKILL exposes an exact pre-transaction or post-transaction logical snapshot with no application-level redo. Ordinary successful lookups remain overflow-independent in the tested envelope and migration source work stays within eight slots/rows.
non_claims: primary logical bucket/stash page probes are not physical SQLite or device page reads
persistent primary tables are themselves SQLite B-trees, so direct-address physical locality is unproven
SQL row-write counts are not WAL frames, filesystem writes, fsync counts, or device write amplification
no multi-writer, distributed-consistency, hardware power-loss beyond the tested stack, or production-latency claim
